H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H7623: properly, to address in aloud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words)
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H1369: force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H1935: grandeur (i.e. an imposing form and appearance)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H7878: to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H2898: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
H5042: to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor)
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H7356: compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H4475: rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler
H5564: to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively, to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense)
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7663: to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H7646: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
